name: 물약 진열장 (cabinet:potion+potionb+potiong)
label: atlas_biome_interior/props34/cabinet:potion+potionb+potiong
reasons: 화풍: 윤곽이 근흑(재질 어두운 톤 아님) (1/4)

answer.evidence: Rows 1-5 form a top band: a darker back row at 1, a lighter brown plane at rows 2-4, and a distinct lighter front-edge line at row 5 (#d59147, L=157). Rows 6-7 are black eave shadow directly under it. The front face runs from row 8 to row 31 (24 rows) and shows potion shelves with shelf-edge strips at rows 12-13, 21-22 and 29-30. Those strips are vertical shelf fronts, not extra tops. The silhouette is a constant 16 px wide, and the top-band plus edge-line plus eave structure matches the green cabinet reference, not the red front-elevation ones.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small shelf cabinet with potion bottles in rows. The numbers are fine: 24 colours per tile, 0% flat fill and 25 distinct colours, so it is not a flat fill and not sparse per tile. The weak points are structure and outline. 68% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, well above the tinted-outline references (hedge 0%, cheese stall 1%). The frame reads as a uniform near-black outline around the whole cabinet and each shelf, which gives the sticker look instead of a dark brown tone beside the wood. The wood frame has only about 3 lightness steps (dark outline, mid brown, one highlight), against 5-6 on the stall and well. Most of the colour count comes from the small bottle accents, not from shaded wood grain or plank texture, so the main material ramp is shallow. It has no scalloped highlights or grain like the cheese stall or the well. I am failing it on the near-black outline and the shallow wood shading, since the measured colour count is partly inflated by the bottles.

answer.evidence: Rows 1-5 form a brown top band, with a lighter 1-row front-edge line at row 5. Rows 6-7 are black eave shadow. Below that, rows 8-31 are the front face: three shelves of potion bottles separated by wood shelf fronts at rows 12-13, 21-22 and 29-30. The structure matches the green bookshelf reference, which also has a top band, edge line and shadow above a front face. The silhouette is a constant 16 px wide, so no side face is drawn.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small potion shelf. It has 25 colours and a median of 24 per tile, which is above the references (stall 17, well 20, hedge 10). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no flat areas. The weaker points are the outline and the shading depth. 68% of its dark edge pixels are near-neutral, higher than the bench (44%), well (33%), stall (1%) and hedge (0%), and only the lamp (100%) is more neutral. The frame therefore reads as a near-black outline rather than a dark brown wood tone. The wood frame and shelf boards show only about 4 lightness steps, against about 5-6 on the well and stall. The bottles add some highlight and colour variation. At 2x the piece looks somewhat sticker-like, with a dark contour around a mostly uniform wood frame and little grain. Density is fine, but the outline and the shallower wood ramp leave doubt, so it fails.

answer.evidence: At the top, rows 1-5 form a lighter wood band (rows 2-4) ending in a light front-edge line at row 5 (#d59147). Rows 6-7 are a black eave shadow under it. Below is a front face of about 26 rows (rows 6-31) with three shelves of bottles. The shelf rows at 12-13, 21-22 and 29-30 are thin front-facing plank edges, not top surfaces. This matches the green bookshelf and cabinet references, which have a top band, an edge line and a shadow. The silhouette is a constant 16 px wide and the cabinet faces south.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small cabinet with a wood frame, shelves and several coloured potion bottles. It has 24 distinct colours per full 16x16 tile, which matches or beats the well (20) and the cheese stall (17), and it has 0% flat-fill coverage. The frame shows about 4 wood steps (highlight, mid, dark, deep), and the bottles carry their own highlights and shades, so the surface has some texture. That is slightly fewer than the 5-6 steps of the references. The outline is the weak point: 68% of dark edge pixels are near-neutral, above the bench (44%) and the well (33%). By eye the frame edge still leans dark brown, and the shelf gaps and bottle edges are separated by value, so I call it mixed rather than a uniform black sticker line. The 25 total colours are fewer than the larger references (38-40), but that fits a small single-tile-wide piece. A careful artist would accept it next to the references, so it passes narrowly.

It carries 25 distinct colours and a median of 24 per full tile, above prop-stall-cheese (17) and prop-well-roofed (20). Flat-fill coverage is 0%, so there are no dead areas. The shelves and bottles give it grain and variation, and the wood frame has about 4 lightness steps against the references' 5-6. The outline is the weak point: 68% of dark edge pixels are neutral, higher than the bench (44%) and the well (33%), though both of those are accepted references. At the board's scale the frame edge reads as dark brown with a neutral lean in places, so I call it mixed rather than a uniform black sticker line. On colours per tile, distinct colours and flat fills it is at or above the references, so it would sit acceptably beside them.
